title: hylotelephium scherfelii
intro: Hylotelephium scherfelii, commonly known as the Korean stonecrop or Sedum scherfelii, is a species of flowering plant in the family Crassulaceae. It is traditionally used in Asian medicine for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Hylotelephium scherfelii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
